statement: SELECT UPPER(TRIM(CAST(k_number AS STRING))) AS held_key, CAST(device_name AS STRING) AS h_device_name, CAST(applicant AS STRING) AS h_applicant, CAST(product_code AS STRING) AS h_product_code, CAST(decision_date AS STRING) AS h_decision_date, CAST(device_class AS STRING) AS h_device_class FROM sk_registry.fda_510k WHERE UPPER(TRIM(CAST(k_number AS STRING))) IN ('K221347')
